items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday (second straight DNP); aggravated in Week 4, looking more doubtful than probable vs DEN.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after aggravation; OL also banged up.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Quentin Johnston if McConkey sits.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Thursday for the second straight day after exiting Week 4 early; week-to-week and not expected to play Week 5 in London vs JAX. Tank Bigsby on IR (core surgery).
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; hamstring strain week-to-week per Rapoport/Schefter context; Bigsby IR leaves backfield thin.
items.implication: Eagles RB room collapses to Shipley primary; high waiver/start priority if rostered.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/snaps/routes for remaining healthy RBs vs JAX.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP Thursday after missing Wednesday and Week 4; trending toward missing Week 5 vs JAX in London with Hollywood Brown also out.
items.why: Back-to-back DNPs on lingering hamstring; depleted PHI pass catchers.
items.implication: Elevates remaining WRs/TE usage for Hurts; Wicks limited but available.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dontayvion Wicks and others.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP Thursday for second straight day; Friday practice looms large for Sunday night availability vs ATL. Outside chance only; multiple games possible miss.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-Week 4 exit; Rapoport outside chance framing.
items.implication: Huntley likely start; Ravens offense downgrade, Flowers/Andrews/Likely impact.
items.opportunity: If out, check Huntley streaming and TE/WR volume shifts.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) DNP Wednesday and not spotted Thursday; week-to-week, expected to miss second straight game vs CLE. Allen handled all RB touches Week 4.
items.why: Multiple DNPs; coach week-to-week; no practice progress.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury aggravated in Week 4.
items.why: Shoulder aggravation forced early exit Week 4; first report of week practice miss.
items.implication: Shakir/Coleman upside if limited or out; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for remaining Bills WRs.

items.text: Broncos HC Sean Payton taking over offensive play-calling ('I’ll call the plays'); change confirmed after earlier collaborative reports. Second HC unit takeover this week (Ryans defense).
items.why: Payton explicit to reporters; prior sources said more involved.
items.implication: Potential scheme/tempo/efficiency boost for DEN offense vs LAC; monitor Nix/Sutton/Harvey usage.
items.opportunity: Possible increased pace, play variety, red-zone creativity under Payton.

items.text: Berry LOVES Nico Collins @ TEN as his WR8; volume/red-zone hog vs Titans defense struggling vs WRs. Strong matchup/volume call.
items.why: Target volume including RZ; TEN struggles vs receivers; Silva/ETR also bullish.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high floor/ceiling in PPR.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/route share in favorable spot.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; workload + defenses carved by RBs; ties to possible Bengals WR injuries (Chase/Higgins) boosting checkdowns.
items.why: Volume hard to ignore; soft run D matchup; WR injury pie potential.
items.opportunity: Carries + targets if CIN WRs limited; third-down/role expansion.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP shows Chase Brown underperforming opportunities YTD.

items.text: If Breece Hall is out, Berry has Braelon Allen as top-20 RB this week; ranks Allen just above Wilson in some spots. Keeping Bucky Irving open as RB15.
items.why: Hall expected out (DNP streak); Allen full prior workload; Irving keep-open despite tough week.
items.implication: Allen must-start RB2/flex; Irving RB2/flex viable.
items.opportunity: Allen near-100% RB snaps/carries/targets vs CLE.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. re-aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis); HC McCarthy says will miss multiple weeks. Elliott returned to practice (still IR).
items.why: Re-aggravation confirmed; multi-week absence per coach/Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Metcalf/Pickens/others target bump in PIT; long-term WR depth hit.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for DK Metcalf and remaining WRs.

items.text: Levitan/ETR: 'I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' after Barkley/Bigsby OUT/IR; primary back in depleted PHI RB room vs JAX London.
items.why: Barkley week-to-week DNP streak + Bigsby IR; Shipley last healthy back; dual-threat history.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 upside on volume alone despite tough JAX run D and low team total; top waiver.
items.opportunity: Projected 10-15+ touches, goal-line/third-down share; Pierce signed as depth.
items.conflict: Matchup is tough (low explosive/success rates allowed); pass-heavy script risk.

items.text: Berry LOVES Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15) and Jaylen Warren vs IND (RB12) if Rico Dowdle remains OUT; also Aaron Jones. Hates Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard, Jordan Addison, Mark Andrews.
items.why: Watson coverage/matchup; Warren workload if Dowdle out; hates on efficiency/game script/role/injury wrinkles.
items.opportunity: Warren full snaps if Dowdle out; Watson routes vs soft CHI.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities so far; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs. Sortable xFP data available to subs.
items.why: Expected vs actual FP analysis through four weeks; opportunity quality metric.
items.implication: Sustain Bijan/Kyren ranks; fade or buy-low Jeanty/Chase Brown if volume holds but efficiency lags.
items.opportunity: Monitor continued role/opportunity for underperformers; red-zone/efficiency edges.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 this week despite underperformance signal.
